blocks.text: You can connect your OpenAI organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Organization Owner privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your OpenAI organization.
To connect your OpenAI organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select OpenAI.
(Optional) In the Add Integration window, enter the Tenant name.
Enter the API key. To learn how to create the API Key, refer to the OpenAI documentation.
When creating the API key, ensure to set the permissions to Read-only.
Click Connect to complete the integration.

blocks.text: Your OpenAI organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
